title: The evolution of the Mini's exterior design
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: The classic Mini changed by details: grille, lights, hinges, trim and special editions more than by silhouette.
content:
The classic Mini's exterior changed less by overall shape than by visible details. Its short body, upright cabin and small wheels remained the same visual base. Grilles, lights, hinges, bumpers and trim tell the period more precisely.

Practical final checks

The generational analysis continues in Mini generations. Interior changes are covered in the Mini interior.

Sources

  • BMW Group PressClub, Classic Mini Timeline: 1959 - 2000
  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
